app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on TU Berlin's doctoral pages; candidates obtain faculty acceptance of their declaration of intent (with foreign degrees checked via the Recognition Office) and pay only semester fees upon enrollment.

also.quote: After your online-application to enrollment has been approved, you will receive an e-mail requesting you to pay the required semester fees.

fee_waiver.value: No doctoral application fee or fee waiver is stated on the TU Berlin pages checked.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE requirement is stated on TU Berlin's doctoral pages.

toefl_min.value: No university-wide TOEFL minimum is stated for doctoral admission; the faculty board's decision on the declaration of intent specifies whether the doctorate will be completed in English or German.
toefl_min.quote: To enroll you must have received the faculty board decision confirming the faculty's acceptance of your declaration of intent to pursue a doctorate and stating whether you will be completing your doctorate in English or German.

ielts_min.value: No university-wide IELTS minimum is stated for doctoral admission on the TU Berlin pages checked.

english_waiver.value: No university-wide English-test exemption rule (including for degrees from India) is stated on TU Berlin's doctoral pages.

notes: Individual doctorates are admitted by the respective faculties (Faculties I, IV, V, VI, VII share joint doctoral regulations; Faculties II and III have separate regulations), followed by online enrollment via tuPORT without uni-assist VPD. Structured doctoral programs may set program-specific English rules. Checked CJS doctorate, legal-issues, international, Recognition & Equivalence (go28637), CJS Onboarding Brochure PDF, applying/enrolling for doctoral studies, and semester-fees pages.
